entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Island east of Aerona in the Domains of Dominaria, and the enlightened nation destroyed by goblins; abandoned by the time of the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Goblins of the Red Mountains
entities.description: Hordes that destroyed Oneah in the Goblin War.

entities.name: Ayesh ni hata Kan
entities.description: Oneahn who believed she was the only survivor of the Fall of Oneah.

entities.name: Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan
entities.description: Oneahn survivor who became a knight in Amjad.

entities.name: Amjad
entities.description: Small human nation in the north of Oneah.

entities.name: Xa-On
entities.description: Beautiful capital of the Oneahn Empire and last city to fall.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Visited abandoned Oneah before the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Juju Bubble
entities.description: Place the survivor directed Sisay and Tahngarth toward.

entities.name: Goblin War
entities.description: War around 4165 AR in which goblins destroyed Oneah.

events.summary: Goblin hordes from the Red Mountains destroy the whole Oneahn Empire around 4165 AR.
events.quote: The whole country was destroyed by hordes of goblins from the Red Mountains

events.summary: Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan survives and becomes a knight in Amjad.
events.quote: Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan also survived, becoming a knight in Amjad

events.summary: Sisay and Tahngarth visit the city abandoned for thirty years and find a survivor who points them toward the Juju Bubble.
events.quote: who pointed them in the direction of the Juju Bubble
